about: WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise whose RADIUS server puts clients in VLANs (0111): VLANs 30 and 40 are offered, each tagged on the uplink with an interface and a wifi-vlan, r30 and r40; a client the server names no VLAN for is refused (vlan_required, dynamic_vlan 2); and 192.168.20.106, a NAC, may disconnect clients on port 3799 with the sign-in secret, as no Disconnect secret is set.
